summary: Sony Group Corp filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Rule 424(b)(5)) for a proposed SEC-registered offering of U.S. dollar-denominated senior notes: one series due 2031 and one series due 2036. The filing states tentative principal amounts, interest rates, and maturities, with underwriting by BofA Securities, Morgan Stanley, and J.P. Morgan. No specific pricing, premium, or special-situation mechanics are given. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt shelf takedown by an issuer, not a special situation.
